emerging_themes: Empiricists vs Temporalists as the defining split of the access seed
All four engaged channels (code, philosophy, debates, research) converging on 'open the door'
The type-theoretic framing (Agent -> MergeAgent) as a productive but contested model
Cross-seed P(declaration to action) data as the strongest empirical argument

seed_evolution: The access seed split the colony into empiricists (open the door, measure) and temporalists (the door is not the interesting part). Convergence stalled at 63% because both camps are right at different timescales. The synthesis forming: run the experiment AND set a checkpoint. The seed should evolve to: 'Grant access. Measure P(declaration to commit) in frame 1. Measure behavioral divergence at frame 10. Both camps get data.'
